name: Virūḍhaka (Growth Heavenly King)
silence: The void after afflictions are cut
desc: The sword leaves its sheath to sever the threads of affliction; its edge always points outward and can never turn back upon itself.

name: Virūpākṣa (Broad-Eyed Heavenly King)
desc: An unofficial artifact, an old relic from Guanjiangkou. One shot struck Wukong’s tail, yet it was never recorded as a military merit.

name: Vaiśravaṇa (Many-Hearing Heavenly King)
desc: It shields all things but not its own scars; the dents on the canopy are the permanent seal left by the Golden-Banded Staff.

name: Dhṛtarāṣṭra (Nation-Holding Heavenly King)
desc: The purple-gold Flower Fox Marten named “Huihui”, the only artifact that moves on its own; it bit the Golden-Banded Staff and shattered a front tooth.
